title: Event Ledger
description: Two Spring Boot microservices processing financial transaction events with idempotency, out-of-order tolerance, layered resiliency, and end-to-end OpenTelemetry tracing.

title: MatrixDB
description: GPU-accelerated analytical database with a lock-free ingestion pipeline, three-tier VRAM/RAM/SSD storage, and byte-for-byte CPU verification of every GPU query result.

title: Software Defined Memory
description: C11 tiered memory manager that transparently moves pages across DRAM, SCM/CXL, GPU VRAM, and NVMe using ML-driven classification and predictive prefetching.

title: On-Device Browser Agent
description: Chrome MV3 agent driven by a local Ollama model; plans multi-step tasks, acts on pages, and verifies claims against a grounded facts ledger, with no cloud or telemetry by default.

title: SDLC Lean
description: Agentic SDLC suite for OpenCode that infers feature, bugfix, refactor, or security pipelines and enforces TDD, review, and verification through dedicated subagents.

title: Quantum ML Research
description: Reproducible hybrid quantum-classical transformer experiments across 20+ tasks and 6-24 qubits, including a rigorous negative result on practical quantum advantage.
